name: HESCAPE
description: Spatial transcriptomics enables simultaneous measurement of gene expression and tissue morphology, offering unprecedented insights into cellular organization and disease mechanisms. However, the field lacks comprehensive benchmarks for evaluating multimodal learning methods that leverage both histology images and gene expression data. Here, we present HESCAPE, a large-scale benchmark for cross-modal contrastive pretraining in spatial transcriptomics, built on a curated pan-organ dataset spanning 6 different gene panels and 54 donors. We systematically evaluated state-of-the-art image and gene expression encoders across multiple pretraining strategies and assessed their effectiveness on two downstream tasks: gene mutation classification and gene expression prediction. reputation: A specialized benchmark for spatial transcriptomics multimodal pretraining, likely of interest to the bioinformatics community but not yet broadly standardized.
notes: Benchmark targets cross-modal pretraining and downstream mutation classification/gene expression prediction; performance depends strongly on encoder choice and dataset composition.
